Open source databases enthusiast specializing in MySQL, Percona XtraDB Cluster, etc. Przemek joined Support Team at Percona in 2012. Before that he spent over five years working for Wikia.com (now Fandom.com) as System Administrator where he was a key person responsible for seamless building up MySQL powered database infrastructure. Besides MySQL he worked on maintaining all other parts of LAMP stack, with main focus on automation, monitoring and backups.
